serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Someone’s calling me at a time like this?! The landlord is running away! And what’s worse, he’s going to the place where Jacobi is hiding! You: Hello? Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: It’s me, you idiot! Repeat after me Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: Oh, hello mamma! Thank you for these enchiladas you made for me. Extra creamy, exactly how i like them! You: O-Oh, hi mom, thanks for the f-food… Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: Really dude, you fucking suck at this. Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: Now listen very carefully and repeat after me: Mommy! How has your job been lately? I know it’s been tough investigating the McMiller & Sons Foundation, but I hope things are getting better! You: How have you been doing? I heard it’s tough investigating the McMiller & Sons Foundation…
